speaker: Alex
text: Hey Mia, how was your weekend getaway?
translation: 嘿米娅，周末旅行怎么样？

speaker: Mia
text: It was fantastic! I went hiking in the mountains near Ashford.
translation: 太棒了！去阿什福德山里徒步了。

speaker: Alex
text: Did you stay in a cabin or a hotel?
translation: 住 cabin 还是酒店？

speaker: Mia
text: A cozy cabin with a fireplace. Perfect for cool evenings.
translation: 一个溪户子，还有火炉，天凉时很舒适。

speaker: Alex
text: That sounds amazing. Did you try any local restaurants?
translation: 听起来 amazing，有去尝本地餐馆吗？

speaker: Mia
text: Yes, there is this little bistro that serves wild game.
translation: 有的，一家小餐馆做野味。

speaker: Alex
text: Wild game? Like venison?
translation: 野味？比如鹿肉吗？

speaker: Mia
text: Exactly. The elk burger was incredible.
translation: 对，鹿肉堡非常棒。

speaker: Alex
text: I am so jealous. Did you take many photos?
translation: 好羡慕，拍了很多照片吗？

speaker: Mia
text: Tons! The fall foliage was absolutely stunning.
translation: 拍了很多！秋叶非常漂亮。

speaker: Alex
text: Speaking of photos, did you post any on social media?
translation: 说到照片，你发社交媒体了吗？

speaker: Mia
text: Just a few highlights. I prefer to live in the moment.
translation: 只发精选，我更喜欢活在当下。

speaker: Alex
text: That is so you. By the way, how is your new job?
translation: 这很像你。对了，你的新工作怎么样？

speaker: Mia
text: It is challenging but rewarding. I love my team.
translation: 有挑战但有回报，很喜欢团队。

speaker: Alex
text: Are you settled in with your desk and everything?
translation: 桌子什么的都整好了吗？

speaker: Mia
text: Almost. Just waiting for my ergonomic chair to arrive.
translation: 差不多，就等人体工学椅了。

speaker: Alex
text: Those are essential for long hours at the computer.
translation: 电脑工作很重要。

speaker: Mia
text: Exactly. Speaking of work, did you hear about the merger?
translation: 对了，听说你们 merger 怎么样？

speaker: Alex
text: Yes, it was announced yesterday. Big changes coming.
translation: 是的，昨天宣布了，有 big changes。

speaker: Mia
text: How will it affect your department specifically?
translation: 对你部门有什么影响？

speaker: Alex
text: We will report to a new VP of Marketing next month.
translation: 下个月汇报给新的 marketing VP。

speaker: Mia
text: That is a significant shift in leadership.
translation: 这是个 significant shift。

speaker: Alex
text: True. I am excited to see how campaigns will evolve.
translation: 是的，很期待 campaigns 怎么变化。

speaker: Mia
text: Do you have meetings to discuss the transition?
translation: 讨论 transition 有会吗？

speaker: Alex
text: Yes, three this week alone. It is going to be busy.
translation: 就这周有3个会，会很忙。

speaker: Alex
text: I can relate. Let us catch up properly this weekend.
translation: 我理解，周末好好聊聊。

speaker: Alex
text: Absolutely. How about Saturday morning?
translation: 好啊，周六早上呢？

speaker: Mia
text: Saturday works. There is a farmers market downtown.
translation: 周六行，有 farmers market。

speaker: Alex
text: Perfect. We can browse the stalls and grab lunch.
translation: 完美，逛摊位找吃的。

speaker: Mia
text: Are you still craving that Thai place near the park?
translation: 还想吃公园附近的泰国菜吗？

speaker: Alex
text: Yes! Their green curry is incredible. Been dreaming about it.
translation: 有！他们 green curry 非常好，做梦都想吃。

speaker: Mia
text: I have been too. Let us make it our lunch spot then.
translation: 我也是，就定他们为午餐吧。

speaker: Alex
text: By the way, I saw the funniest thing this morning.
translation: 对了，今天早上看到乐事。

speaker: Mia
text: Do tell! What happened?
translation: [laughing] Did people react?

speaker: Alex
text: A dog in a business suit was riding the subway.
translation: 一只穿西装的狗坐地铁。

speaker: Mia
text: [laughing] Did people react?
translation: [大笑] 人们有反应吗？

speaker: Alex
text: Yes, everyone was taking photos.
translation: 有的，都在拍照。

speaker: Mia
text: That is hilarious. I wish I had seen it.
translation: 真好笑，真希望我能看到。

speaker: Alex
text: Next time I will text you immediately.
translation: 下次我会马上发短信。

speaker: Alex
text: Speaking of lunch, do you prefer indoor or outdoor?
